Class JdbcActionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.cayenne.dba.JdbcActionBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
SQLActionVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
DB2ActionBuilder, DerbyActionBuilder, FirebirdActionBuilder, FrontBaseActionBuilder, H2ActionBuilder, IngresActionBuilder, SQLServerActionBuilder
public class JdbcActionBuilder extends Object implements SQLActionVisitor
A factory of default SQLActions. Adapters usually subclass JdbcActionBuilder to provide custom actions for various query types.
Since:
1.2
